journey.name: DD-04 The relative wording stops at seven days
journey.description:
Covers the boundary in FR-13 that RelativeDateTest pins at the unit level and that nothing has checked on a real screen: MAX_RELATIVE_DAYS is 7 (RelativeDate.kt:79), so a date seven days out is still counted in days and a date eight days out falls back to an absolute, locale-formatted date.
The cutover is computed in the device's own time zone, so run this on a device whose clock and zone are correct. If the device is near midnight the day count can legitimately shift by one; re-run rather than filing a defect.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Select the date exactly seven days from today and tap "OK"
Verify that the due date reads "Due in 7 days"
Select the date exactly eight days from today and tap "OK"
Verify that the due date no longer counts days and instead shows a calendar date, beginning with "Due "
Verify that the "Book dentist" row on the list shows that same calendar date
